newsitem.title: UK: Orange Q1 subscriber base rises to 894,000.
newsitem.headline: Orange Q1 subscriber base rises to 894,000.

text.p: British mobile phone operator Orange Plc said on Wednesday that the subscriber base for its wirefree network rose 109,000 to 894,000 in the first quarter of 1997.
The company said churn had stayed in line with expectations and equalled a rate of 19.1 percent over the past 12 months.
"In the first quarter, we have continued our rapid growth while retaining the lowest churn rate in the industry," Orange said in a statement.
